scope: Frozen before reading round 4 donor results. Paired system diagnostic on the same 24 physical garments as round 4 (distinct from round 3). No new weights or training. One eligible 2B stock scorer plus the directly edited compact textile expert. Only the scored region of the already-known oracle arm uses published geometry.
question: Use the stock gear-2 broken-material question verbatim on every rendition. Round 2 showed this is a strong incumbent with fewer calls.
selection: All 24 stage 4 source item IDs, one region per image. The learned proposal is the highest absolute hole-or-stain anchor across the image, with original hole logit reconstructed from the invertible head. Do not let annotations select the anchor or crop size. Map the decoded anchor box back to the oriented native image; clamp to image and choose 3x its longest side or 64 px minimum. Resize the square to 512. The fixed-center control uses exactly the same native pixel size. Use the already frozen whole photo and analyst-independent publisher-box region as the other two arms.
outcomes: Primary: AUROC of max(full broken score, proposed-detail broken score) vs whole alone AND max(full, equal-size centered crop); report each raw view's ranking and known-location upper reference separately. Expert scores fit under the same cap as the 2B model. Count correct proposal coverage by class, decision-work costs and annotation-size distribution. A model may flag a crop but never use this experiment to clear a garment.
screen: Keep learned proposals as a candidate only if fused ranking beats both controls. Single vendor/24 items does not qualify routing without new motorcycle gear. A lower metric retires automatic use, even if the oracle arm is strong.
